g.text: Greg Berlanti to Receive the Paley Center for Media’s Honors Award at Its Fall Gala ◆ Brian Gordon Takes Executive Producer, Head of Live Content Roles at PGA Tour Studios ◆ Lula’s Election Win: How Taylor’s Swift’s Advice to Fandom Helped Him to a Historic Victory and Defeat for Trump ◆ Trump Calls Bill Maher a ‘Complete and Total Loser,’ Tells Him ‘Don’t Call Anymore’ in Lengthy Truth Social Post ◆ John Oliver Issues Urgent Warning Ahead of Midterms About the Republican Party’s Nazi Ties ◆ Peggy King, ‘George Gobel Show’ Actress and Singer of the ’50s, Dies at 96 ◆
